title: Could have, Would have, Should have

vocabulary.meaning_en: a chance you had in the past but did not use
vocabulary.example: Not studying abroad was a lost opportunity.
This job is a great opportunity.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to lose the chance to do or have something good
vocabulary.example: Don't miss out on this free course.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a mistake; to do something badly (informal)
to feel sad because of something you did or didn't do
vocabulary.example: He feels sorry about his mistake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not real; only in your mind
a promise that something will certainly happen
vocabulary.example: It's possible, but there's no guarantee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a reason you give for not doing something
vocabulary.note_en: Noun ends with /s/; the verb ends with /z/.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the third form of a verb (helped, done, gone)
a plan of times for doing things

fine_lines.title: could have vs would have vs should have
fine_lines.explanation_ar: could have + PP: كان ممكنًا في الماضي ولم يحدث. would have + PP: تخيّلتُ أنني سأفعله (غالبًا مع شرط) ولم يحدث. should have + PP: كان هو الصواب أو الأفضل ولم يحدث (ندم أو لوم).
fine_lines.explanation_en: could have + PP: it was possible, but it didn't happen. would have + PP: I imagined doing it (often with a condition), but it didn't happen. should have + PP: it was the right or best thing, but it didn't happen (regret or criticism).

examples.sentence: I could have helped you on Tuesday, but now it's Thursday.
I would have come if I had known.
I should have studied more for the test.

fine_lines.title: could vs could have
fine_lines.explanation_ar: could + المصدر: احتمال في المستقبل (ما زالت الفرصة موجودة). could have + PP: احتمال في الماضي (ضاعت الفرصة).
fine_lines.explanation_en: could + base verb: a possible future (the chance is still there). could have + PP: a past possibility (the chance is gone).

examples.sentence: I could have helped you yesterday.

expressions.meaning_ar: كان بالإمكان، كنتُ سأفعل، كان يجب... (لكن لم يحدث)
expressions.meaning_en: An idiom: talking about chances you missed; it's too late now.
expressions.example: Coulda, woulda, shoulda. It's too late to change it now.

expressions.phrase: I would love to help you.
expressions.meaning_en: A polite, positive answer (maybe not certain).
expressions.example: I would love to help you. I just have to check my schedule.

expressions.phrase: I would do it if I were you.
expressions.example: Take the job. I would do it if I were you.
The sale ends today. Don't miss out!

grammar.title: Could, would, should: possible futures
grammar.explanation_ar: could = ممكن، would = متخيَّل (وأيضًا ماضي will)، should = الصواب أو الأفضل. معها المصدر، وهي تتحدث عن مستقبل ممكن، أي شيء لا نفعله الآن.
grammar.explanation_en: could = possible, would = imaginary (also the past of will), should = the right or best thing. With a base verb, they talk about a possible future, something we are not doing now.
examples: I could help you tomorrow if I'm free.
I would help you, but I'm busy.
I should help you because you need it.

grammar.title: Modal + have + past participle = lost opportunity
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما نضيف have + التصريف الثالث بعد could/would/should يصبح الكلام عن الماضي: الفرصة كانت موجودة لكنها ضاعت. have تعني الربط بالماضي.
grammar.explanation_en: When we add have + past participle after could/would/should, we talk about the past: the chance was there but now it is gone. Have shows a connection to the past.
examples: I could have gone to the meeting. (It was possible; I didn't go.)
I would have called, but I lost my phone.
You should have told me earlier.

grammar.title: After should have: use necessity now
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما تضيع الفرصة (should have)، غالبًا نحتاج الآن لفعل شيء آخر، فنستخدم أفعال الضرورة must / have to / need to.
grammar.explanation_en: When the chance is gone (should have), we often need to do something else now, so we use necessity modals: must / have to / need to.
examples: I should have studied. Now I have to take the test again.
You should have left earlier. Now you need to take a taxi.

questions.question: "I could have helped you" means ___.
choices: It was possible, but I didn't help.
questions.explanation_ar: could have + PP = كان ممكنًا ولم يحدث.
questions.explanation_en: Could have + PP = it was possible, but it didn't happen.

questions.question: You failed the test. "I ___ studied more."
questions.explanation_ar: ندم على الماضي: should have + PP.
questions.explanation_en: Regret about the past: should have + PP.

questions.question: What does "have" add to the modal?
Which modal is about something imaginary?
"I ___ come if I had known about the party."
questions.explanation_ar: would have + PP مع شرط في الماضي.
questions.explanation_en: would have + PP with a past condition.

questions.question: What is a "lost opportunity"?
choices: a chance you did not use
questions.explanation_en: A chance you did not use.

questions.question: "I could help you tomorrow." The chance is ___.
questions.explanation_en: Could + base verb = a possible future.

questions.question: What does "miss out" mean?
questions.explanation_en: Miss out = to lose a good chance.

questions.question: "You should have left earlier. Now you ___ take a taxi."
questions.explanation_en: Now it's a necessity: have to.
